settings.title: Settings
help.title: How does it work?
help.intro: A free library for your 3D-printing files (STL, 3MF, OBJ). Everything stays on this device: nothing is uploaded and your original files are never changed.
help.step.add: Add: tap Add and choose files or a whole folder, or drag them into the window.
help.step.view: View: tap a model to rotate and zoom. The dimensions are shown below it.
help.step.name: Name: give each model its own name, tags and a note, so you know later what is what.
help.step.tidy: Select: tick models (top right) to move them to a folder, tag them or delete them together. Folders live inside the app; your files on disk are not touched.
help.step.dupes: Duplicates: find identical files under different names and clear them out.
help.step.colours: Colours: 3MF colours from Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and PrusaSlicer are shown. For OBJ, select the .mtl file together with the .obj.
help.step.backup: Backup: your library only lives in this browser. Make a backup now and then in Settings, also to switch devices.
help.step.install: Install: choose "Add to Home Screen" (iPhone/iPad via Share, Android via the menu) to use it as an app, also offline.

disk.title: Disk (Chrome/Edge on desktop)
disk.unsupported: Not available in this browser. Linking a folder only works in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
disk.hint: Link a folder on your computer. Then the app can also really rename and move files on disk if you switch that on here. By default everything only happens inside the app.
disk.syncinfo: On: a new name renames the file, choosing a folder moves it into that folder and deleting can also remove the file from your disk (always with an extra question, cannot be undone). Changes you make outside the app are only noticed after Scan again.
disk.nopermission: No access to the folder. Give permission or link the folder again.
disk.on: Disk link is on: files are also changed on disk.
disk.skipobj: OBJ with a colour file (.mtl) stays where it is on disk, otherwise the link would break.
disk.missing: File no longer found on disk: {name}. Scan the folder again.
help.step.disk: Disk (optional): in Chrome or Edge on a computer you can link a folder in Settings, so renaming and moving also really happens on disk. Deleting from disk always asks an extra confirmation. Off by default.
del.title: Remove?
del.keepfiles: Your original files on your device stay where they are.
del.diskwarning: {n} of these models are linked to a file on your disk. You can also delete that file from your disk. This is permanent: there is no recycle bin.
settings.import.hint: Choose the .zip file of your backup. If you do not see it, pick another location in the file picker (e.g. Downloads or the folder where you received it).
import.nomtl: {n} OBJ model(s) point to a .mtl file that was not added, so the colours are missing. Add the .obj together with the .mtl file from the same folder.
